F5.system: 1080-qubit quasi-local zero-T 60-site Lindblad CPTP bath + QPD-coupled 4x27q PyQrack + Heisenberg g

pyqrack_module_flow.pyqrack_4x27q_coupling_method: Mitarai-Fujii Strang-QPD circuit knitting across ALL 32/32 Module-0 K4 seam bonds (142 bonds total, 4 independent QrackSimulator(27) workers, all-order final-layer diag + all cross-seam pairs (e1,e2)) + 25k-shot seeded 2-Strang-step MC QPD + 6-step 1-ebit Cat-entangler LOCC teleportation

pyqrack_multistep_mc_qpd_audit.ebit_shot_assumption: Flat 10^4 shots (eps=1e-2) assumes distilled logical ebits with 1-F_ebit <= 0.01/N_ebits split evenly between distillation residual and storage decoherence, fault-tolerant local gates (required once eps_req < 1e-3, e.g. 1.92e-6 at 5200 ebits), a depolarising pair memory with T_mem/t_round >= 3(r+1)/(2 eps_req), and 1 LOCC feed-forward round per Trotter step.

sampling_cost_table.regime: 2x27q MC shot-sampled (1 bridge, 2 Strang steps, 3 cuts)
4x27q ALL 32 seams (10 Trotter steps, dt=0.05, T=0.50)

pyqrack_ebit_cat_entangler_audit.protocol: 1-ebit Cat-entangler LOCC gate teleportation (Bell pair + 2 classical bits/cut); single-simulator circuit-identity check (22q exact complex128 + 22q/28q PyQrack) + 1,000 real repeated end-to-end circuit executions (10q, ideal F=1.0 vs noisy Werner F=0.80) + exact Pauli-pattern-enumerated noisy-ebit reference

circuit_identity.note: Both halves share one classical state vector. The exact complex128 run verifies the circuit identity; the PyQrack runs measure simulator numerics, which grow with width and with mid-circuit measurements.

optimisation.optimiser_method: scipy.optimize.minimize(Powell, baseline x0 only, pure 3D Biot-Savart, <J_rad>=<J_ins>=1.0, zero penalty cliffs)
